alex: Hi — considering taking a 401(k) loan to cover a medical bill. Curious about timing: if I submit a loan request now, when will funds actually disburse? Also any impacts on matching or vesting?

mira (People Ops): Hey @alex, generally vendor processes loan requests in 5-7 business days after receiving a completed loan form and ID verification. Disbursement timeline can vary by vendor. Employer match and vesting aren't affected by a loan (you're borrowing from your vested balance), but loan repayments are made via payroll after disbursement and will reduce your net pay by the repayment amount.

alex: Got it. Does taking a loan pause my ability to change deferral % or enroll in catch-up while repayment is happening?

mira (People Ops): You can still change your deferral elections and enroll in catch-up; loan repayment is separate and shows as a payroll deduction line item. Just be mindful of cash flow when increasing deferrals while repaying a loan.

benefits-vendor-bot: Benefits Vendor: Standard loan docs required: signed loan agreement, proof of ID, and electronic signature. Loan processing ETA: 3-10 business days depending on verification. For medical hardship loans, vendor may require supporting docs; if this is a hardship distribution rather than a loan, different rules and taxes apply.

alex: If I choose a 401k loan instead of hardship withdraw, what about taxes and penalties?

mira (People Ops): Loans avoid immediate taxes/penalties if repaid on schedule. Hardship distributions are taxable and may incur penalties if you're under 59.5. Also a hardship reduces your plan balance permanently. We usually recommend loan when feasible.

payroll-bot: Payroll reminder: Loan repayments begin the first payroll after disbursement. To change repayment frequency or amount (within plan rules), submit the Repayment Election Form within 5 business days of disbursement. Off-cycle payroll adjustments require a payroll ticket.

alex: Thanks — I'll submit the loan form tonight. Mira, I'll DM the completed form so People Ops can attach to the vendor ticket.
